summary: Hydro One Networks Inc., subsidiary of Hydro One Limited (TSX: H), filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 7, 2026 news release announcing submission of its 2028-2032 Joint Rate Application to the Ontario Energy Board. The roughly $37 billion five-year transmission and distribution investment plan targets reliability, security and capacity for about 6,000 MW of new load, modernization of roughly 1,400 km of transmission lines, over 85,000 distribution poles, smart switching on about 90% of major distribution lines, 5,400 residential energy storage systems and strengthened physical and cyber security. No securities transaction, no board recommendation and no advisor are disclosed. This is a routine regulatory rate filing, not a special situation; watch OEB approval timing and rate outcomes.
